name: Alphalogic Techsys Limited
about: Alphalogic Techsys Limited, together with its subsidiary, provides information technology consulting solutions and support services in India. It operates through Information Technology, Biofuels, and Investment segments. The company provides SaaS platforms, ecommerce, enterprise applications, APIs and integrations; mobile apps, such as iOS, android, cross-platform apps, backends and APIs; research, information architecture, and design systems and interactive prototypes; build CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and cloud architecture; data pipelines, data warehousing, dashboards, and analytics; and discovery, market analysis, roadmapping, success metrics. It also offers bioethanol., as well as Further, engages in design, manufacturing, supply, and installation of industrial racks and storage solutions. It serves healthcare, SaaS Software, e-commerce, and fintech industries. The company was formerly known as Alphalogic Inc and changed its name to Alphalogic Techsys Limited in December 2018. Alphalogic Techsys Limited was founded in 2008 and is based in Pune, India.
